scenarios.name: Hero Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify the hero section displays product name, tagline, and value proposition prominently (REQ-1)

steps.description: Navigate to the MirDB landing page in a web browser
steps.context: Fresh page load with cleared cache

steps.description: Check that the hero section is visible above the fold
steps.context: Standard desktop viewport (1920x1080)

steps.description: Confirm 'MirDB' product name is prominently displayed in the hero section
steps.context: Product name should be in a heading tag (h1)

steps.description: Confirm tagline 'Persistent Memcached-compatible key-value store' is visible
steps.context: Tagline should clearly communicate the value proposition

test_cases.input: Load landing page and inspect hero section
test_cases.expected: Hero section contains h1 with 'MirDB' text
Tagline text 'Persistent Memcached-compatible key-value store' is visible

test_cases.input: Verify hero section is above the fold on desktop
test_cases.expected: Hero section is fully visible without scrolling on 1920x1080 viewport

steps.description: Scroll to or click navigation to reach the features section
steps.context: Features section should be easily accessible

steps.description: Check that Memcached protocol compatibility is highlighted as a key feature
steps.context: Feature should mention drop-in replacement capability

steps.description: Check that data persistence is highlighted as a key differentiator
steps.context: Feature should contrast with standard Memcached's volatility

steps.description: Check that LSM tree architecture is mentioned for technical credibility
steps.context: Should mention write-optimized workloads

test_cases.input: Check features section for Memcached compatibility content
test_cases.expected: Features section contains text about Memcached protocol compatibility

test_cases.input: Check features section for persistence content
test_cases.expected: Features section contains text about data persistence and SSTable storage

test_cases.input: Check features section for LSM architecture content
test_cases.expected: Features section contains text about LSM tree architecture

test_cases.input: Verify features grid layout with 3-4 items
test_cases.expected: Features section displays 3-4 key differentiators in a grid layout
